entries.logic: Scans for local include patterns (#include "...") and verifies if the targeted header exists in the src/ directory.
entries.rationale: Ensures that all local references are valid and prevents broken builds due to missing files.

entries.logic: Identifies if Header A includes Header B while Header B also includes Header A, a situation that causes compilation errors or infinite pre-processing.
entries.rationale: Maintains a clean directed acyclic graph (DAG) for the project structure, facilitating faster compilation.
